# cozystack_vminstance (Resource)

A Cozystack virtual machine instance, deployed inside a tenant namespace. The deprecated subnets list is not managed (use networks instead).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cozystack_vmdisk" "os" {
  name      = "vm-os"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
  storage   = "20Gi"
  source    = { image = { name = "ubuntu" } }
}

resource "cozystack_vminstance" "vm" {
  name      = "vm"
  namespace = "tenant-root"

  instance_type    = "u1.medium"
  instance_profile = "ubuntu"
  run_strategy     = "Always"

  disks = [
    { name = cozystack_vmdisk.os.name },
  ]

  external       = true
  external_ports = [22]
  ssh_keys       = ["ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAA user@example.com"]

  cloud_init = <<-EOT
    #cloud-config
    packages:
      - qemu-guest-agent
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VMInstance instance name (`metadata.name`). Immutable.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace the application is created in. Immutable.

### Optional

- `cloud_init` (String) Cloud-init user data.
- `cloud_init_seed` (String) Seed string used to generate the SMBIOS UUID for the VM.
- `cpu_model` (String) CPU model exposed inside the VM.
- `disks` (Attributes List) Disks to attach. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `external` (Boolean) Enable external access from outside the cluster.
- `external_allow_icmp` (Boolean) Accept ICMP traffic to the VM in PortList mode (preserves ping and PMTU discovery).
- `external_method` (String) Method to pass through traffic to the VM (`PortList` or `WholeIP`).
- `external_ports` (List of Number) Ports to forward from outside the cluster.
- `gpus` (Attributes List) GPUs to attach (NVIDIA driver requires at least 4 GiB RAM). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpus))
- `instance_profile` (String) Virtual machine preferences profile.
- `instance_type` (String) Virtual machine instance type.
- `networks` (Attributes List) Networks to attach the VM to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
- `resources` (Attributes) Explicit CPU, memory, and socket configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `run_strategy` (String) Requested running state of the VM instance.
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) SSH public keys for authentication.
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Block on create/update until the tenant's `Ready` condition is true.
- `wait_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait when `wait_for_ready` is set (Go duration, e.g. `10m`).

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version (`status.version`).
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier in the form `namespace/name`.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.

- `bus` (String) Disk bus type (e.g. `sata`, `virtio`).

### Nested Schema for `resources`

Optional:

- `cpu` (String) Number of CPU cores allocated.
- `memory` (String) Amount of memory allocated.
- `sockets` (String) Number of CPU sockets (vCPU topology).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# VMInstance instances are imported as "<namespace>/<name>".
terraform import cozystack_vminstance.vm tenant-root/vm
```
